8.6.3 Configurable interfaces
In this section, all interfaces are listed where the target function could be configured.
The target function is usually a callback function. The names of this kind of interfaces
are not fixed because they are configurable.
Note: The return value of the callback C-APIs is defined as Std_ReturnType to
follow the signature of the corresponding service APIs. According to [4] Chapter 8.4
“Callback notifications” the caller, i.e. the StbM, can assume, that the callback will
always return E_OK.
